Package com.agrialert.ui.alerts

Class AlertSettingUiModel

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.ui.alerts.AlertSettingUiModel
public class AlertSettingUiModel extends Object
UI Model representing an alert configuration setting. This model holds the state for an alert type, including its enabled status and up to two configurable thresholds.
